confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sicilian and Italian pricing for a July peak-season window; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with season, location and availability. Cocktail and wine_glass were not priced directly: they were set from the local beer anchor (cocktail about 1.7x beer, wine glass about 1x beer). FX caveat: the 0.6947 USD-per-AUD value for 2026-10-16 was reported by a third-party page (ozfinancehub.com.au) and a secondary search summary, and I could not confirm it on rba.gov.au. Verify it against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against southern Italian mid-sized cities with similar tourist demand and Italian restaurant and café pricing (for example Naples and Catania), adjusted for Palermo's summer tourist peak and generally lower hotel rates than Rome or Florence.
